subject: Brightline: EOQ conversion credit offer and timing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightline — quick credit ask for EOQ close

Ben / Priyom,

Quick background: Brightline (Olivia / Dan) are at an executive decision point — legal is done, procurement asks for a committed spend timeline. They ran the pilot successfully and are leaning to convert, but want a commercial sweetener to sign before EOW. Pipeline impact would be material for our Q1 numbers.

Proposal I want to move fast on: one-time platform credit of $18,000 applied at contract activation + a 90-day free trial window (no overage billing) to give them runway to scale the POC to production. We would require a 12-month contract commit and standard dedicated terms.

Ask: Can you draft the external offer and confirm finance sign-off path? If this is reasonable, please include required internal approvals and a short risk note if we expose credits pre-activation. I know finance (Vivek) has been conservative — looping him in.

Target: send offer to Brightline by EOD today (31-Mar).

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Brightline — quick credit ask for EOQ close

Thanks Naomi — drafted below is a concise external offer we can send. Priyom, please confirm legal okay with the 90-day trial language; Vivek, please confirm accounting treatment and whether $18k needs exec approval or fits within our field discount band.

--- DRAFT EMAIL TO BRIGHTLINE ---
From: Ben Carter (Redwood)
To: Olivia Park (Brightline)
Subject: Redwood — EOQ offer to accelerate production

Hi Olivia / Dan,

Really enjoyed the wrap-up demo last week — the results look promising. To make the transition to production straightforward, Redwood is prepared to offer Brightline the following limited-time incentive:

- One-time account credit of $18,000 to be applied at contract activation
- 90-day extended trial period during which Brightline will not incur overage charges on metered usage (standard usage caps apply)
- 12-month committed term at the quoted pricing in the attached MAP (Brightline_MAP_v2.pdf)

If this looks good, we can cut the order form and aim for execution before the end of the quarter. I can share a credit terms addendum if you need it.

Best,
Ben
--- end draft ---

I recommend we attach the MAP and a short credit terms addendum (see attached redlines). If Vivek confirms accounting, I can send this now.

Ben

Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightline — quick credit ask for EOQ close

Ben / Naomi — thanks for the heads-up. Quick finance view:

- $18k one-time credit is acceptable within regional quota approvals; does not require CFO sign-off if tied to a signed 12-month commitment and recognized as deferred revenue offset.
- Need the credit terms addendum to specify that the credit applies after the order is active and will be amortized against invoices; no upfront cash refund.
- Confirm that trial window does not change data residency/SLA commitments — if they require SLAs we need to reflect that in the order form.

If legal approves the language on trial/overages, you have my sign-off to proceed with the offer. Please include accounting contact (finance-invoice@redwood.com) on the order form routing.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Olivia Park <olivia@brightline.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan@brightline.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood — EOQ offer to accelerate production

Ben / Naomi,

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the generous proposal — this is exactly the kind of runway we need to go from pilot to production. A few asks from our side before we sign: 

1) Can the 90-day trial window be extended to 120 days? Our security team has a mandatory review that often adds 30 days for SOC evidence and firewall changes.
2) We need a short clause that credits cannot be applied to third-party marketplace fees (we'll need to route via our procurement team).
3) Can you include a target SLO for model availability (we're expecting 99.5% monthly uptime for our baseline workload)?

If those are acceptable, we can sign the order form this week and aim to activate as early as next week. We appreciate the flexibility — this makes the financial case very easy for our CFO.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Data Products
Brightline Analytics
olivia@brightline.ai
+1 617-555-0789

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightline — EOQ conversion credit offer and timing

Looping back with the internal plan based on Olivia's asks: 

- Legal: I reviewed the redlines. We can accept the 120-day trial extension but will require a short amendment that clarifies scope of trial (usage caps and data processing terms unchanged). I'll produce the amendment and attach to the order form.
- Finance: Vivek, per your note we will amortize the $18k credit post-activation. Confirmed — include finance-invoice@redwood.com on routing.
- Product/Reliability: SLO request (99.5%) is within our Dedicated tier SLAs; marketing/ops will ensure it's written into the order form as the baseline commitment.

Plan: Ben, send the updated offer to Brightline with these items: 120-day trial, credit terms addendum language, and a clause excluding marketplace fees. Attach Brightline_MAP_v2.pdf and the credit terms redlines. Copy finance-invoice@redwood.com and legal@redwood.com for routing.

Once they confirm, Naomi, please escalate the order through the HubSpot deal workflow so we can hit Q1 closure numbers.

— Priyom
